manifest.method: For each tokenizer and pair, len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)); equal mean over all 12 fresh pairs per tokenizer; headline = maximum tokenizer mean (least-favourable), lo/hi = tokenizer span. Comparator: complete-careful-English (full semantics stated once, plainly) — mid-explicitness between d9045f24 terse glosses and 8b57208e fully-spelled-out glosses, to test comparator-relativity of token_delta.
